4_door: an empty narrow London back street at night, seen from the cobbles: two doors from the corner a sinister two-storey block of building thrusts its gable forward onto the street; it shows no window at all, only one blistered, discoloured, paint-stained door with neither bell nor knocker, set in a shallow recess at the top of worn stone steps, and above it a blind forehead of stained, discoloured wall; wet black cobbles, one gas lamp glowing through thick yellow fog, deep shadow, no people, no figures.
